reporting_constraints: Visible report outputs cannot exceed upstream support.
Executive summaries must not use narrative force to strengthen claims beyond support.
forbidden_output_families: The report must not package preliminary findings as verified conclusions.
Tables do not become evidence by default unless source and relevance are clear.
certainty_constraints: Recommendations must remain scoped to the evidence grade that supports them.
evidence_traceability_expectations: Reports must preserve enough source context for a reviewer to inspect each major claim.
